name: Farber Lipogranulomatosis

criteria.description: Demonstration of acid ceramidase enzyme deficiency in leukocytes or fibroblasts
Presence of the clinical triad: painful progressive joint deformities, subcutaneous nodules, and hoarseness of voice
Histopathological identification of lipogranulomas in affected tissues
Identification of pathogenic mutations in ASAH1 gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of acid ceramidase deficiency plus clinical triad or histopathological confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory if enzyme assay and clinical features are definitive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Hoarseness of voice due to laryngeal involvement

common.symptomName: Swelling and tenderness of affected joints
Subcutaneous nodules on fingers and joints

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory distress due to laryngeal or pulmonary involvement

laboratory: Reduced acid ceramidase enzyme activity in leukocytes or fibroblasts
Elevated ceramide levels in tissues and plasma
imaging: X-ray showing joint deformities and osteolytic lesions
MRI may show soft tissue nodules and joint involvement
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in ASAH1 gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing
other: Histopathology revealing characteristic lipogranulomas with foamy macrophages

distinguishingFeatures: Glucocerebrosidase deficiency instead of acid ceramidase
Presence of Gaucher cells on histology
Different pattern of organomegaly and bone involvement

redFlags: Rapidly progressive joint deformities in infancy
Presence of subcutaneous nodules with pain
Hoarseness or respiratory distress due to laryngeal involvement
references: Farber S. Lipogranulomatosis. A new lipid storage disease. J Lab Clin Med. 1957;49(4):545-58.

Schuchman EH, Desnick RJ. Types A and B Niemann-Pick disease. In: Scriver CR, et al., editors. The Metabolic and Molecular Bases of Inherited Disease. 8th ed. New York: McGraw-Hill; 2001. p. 3589-3610.
Hollak CE, et al. Farber disease: clinical and biochemical features. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2013;8:23.
